title: Show supplier purchase exposure amount summaries in report designer
description: A purchasing user chooses a finite amount summary and sees original-currency current-page evidence beside the selected-column preview. Development only. Reuse ERP-148 authorized bounded preview over ERP-031; keep all grouping to the current page, recheck current-user purchase-order menu and use existing HTTP operation audit. Preserve unknown settlement/receipt evidence, distinct currencies and ambiguous/unavailable links; never infer an accounts-payable balance or payment authority. Invalid modes and missing permission fail closed. No arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Designer offers only ERP-154 monetary summary modes and sends them with the current filtered bounded request.
View labels supplier, currency, link state, ordered and known settlement evidence; unlinked exposure and unknown amounts stay separate, with visible empty/permission/network states.
Node tests cover mode selection, currencies, unknown/link states, safe text rendering, paging and failures; document summary and download scope.
